module_summary: AXI-Lite write-channel width adapter: a 3-state FSM (IDLE/DATA/RESP) forwards AW, W and B between slave and master ports, replicating/shifting data or splitting into segments for narrower masters.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DATA/RESP controller sequencing address, data and response transfers.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write address valid; accepted in IDLE to launch master AW.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Slave AW ready from registered ready, raised when master AW is free.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write address copied to master address and segment index.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data replicated or segmented into master write data.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write data valid accepted in DATA state.

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: Slave write data ready from registered ready.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write response valid, set after master response(s) complete.

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Master write address register, incremented per segment.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid; held until master awready, blocks new slave AW.

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Master write data valid; gates slave wready.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master write response valid; completes RESP state.

anchors.name: m_axil_bready
anchors.why: Master response ready, asserted in RESP when slave B is free.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Holds wide slave write data across segmented master writes.

anchors.name: strb_reg
anchors.why: Holds slave write strobes across segmented writes.

anchors.name: current_segment_reg
anchors.why: Segment counter selecting data slice; wrap to zero ends the burst.

groups.name: Write FSM
groups.description: Sequences AW acceptance, W transfer and B response.

groups.name: Slave write port
groups.description: Registered ready/response signals for the slave AXI-Lite write port.

groups.name: Master write port
groups.description: Registered address, data, strobe and handshakes driving the master port.

groups.name: Width conversion buffer
groups.description: Holds wide data/strobe and steps segments for narrower master bus.
